title: Evidence Adequacy Score
interpretation: Coverage and evidence-review quality score; NOT probability of novelty.

criteria.name: Direct-domain search coverage
criteria.proof: Search queries, date range, databases and retrieval log

criteria.name: Cross-disciplinary search coverage
criteria.proof: Alternative terms, mathematical/function abstractions and adjacent fields

criteria.name: Source quality and accessibility
criteria.proof: Verified accessible sources and access-depth limitations

anchors.0: No required evidence or process performed.
anchors.3: Good documented coverage and limited remaining uncertainty.
anchors.4: Comprehensive documented coverage and independent verification appropriate to scope.
